rv.q: Heroes of the Fourth Turning will keep you thinking about the difficult questions asked and facts revealed long after leaving the theater.
Arbery is a writer of depth and originality whose genius shines through the limitations of this production.

cn.t: Arbery's Pulitzer-nominated drama earns strong praise, with critics recommending this award-winning exploration of ideology and conflict that sparked acclaim in its 2019 debut and continues to resonate in this production.
